summary: Ardmore Shipping Corp filed a Form 6-K with its quarterly earnings press release for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports adjusted net income of $23.6 million ($0.58 per share), a dividend increase to $0.39 per share (two-thirds payout ratio), the order of two newbuild tankers at $44.9 million each with options, and the sale of the Ardmore Engineer for $35.5 million. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. This is a routine earnings release with operational highlights, not a special situation.
